name: page-read
description: What one load of a live page says about itself before anyone clicks: console, labels, state attributes, sections, canvases, animations, capabilities, fonts, and the targets a sweep can hover or click. Needs Google Chrome. Never cached.

verbs.name: facts
verbs.description: Load a page once in headless Chrome and read what it says about itself. Prints a short summary, or the facts with --json.

loadMs.description: How long to wait after load before reading, for pages that assemble themselves.
